notes: Step 1 parts were correct, so none were added or dropped.

The image shows the breadboard with rows j-f in the top half and e-a in the bottom half. The catalogue calls rows a-e bank 't' and rows f-j bank 'b'. So the image's bottom half is bank 't' and its top half is bank 'b'.

Pot positions are read from the image. Its left pin is in column 10, bottom half (10t.e), and goes to GND. Its right pin is in column 12, bottom half (12t.e), and goes to 5V. Its centre pin is in column 11, top half (11b.f), and is the wiper to A0.
The black wire is in 10t.d and the red wire in 12t.d. Each shares a column strip with the matching pot pin. The yellow wire is in 11b.g, in the same strip as the wiper pin.
The black wire goes to a GND pin on the Uno power header. I used GND.2, because the image doesn't show which of the Uno's GND ports that pin is.
The tutorial text says one outer pin goes to 5V and the other to ground. The image and schematic fix which is which, and the potentiometer is symmetric for GND and VCC anyway.
No resistor or LED is used in this tutorial.
